scope: Round-2 spec re-review of the issue #50 change after fixes for the round-1 findings: deferred T07 amendment and data-policy approval to the correction receipt, repeated-requests construction text, repository-cost statement, loader enforcement and its test.

checks.question: 1. Protocol changes confined to the named fields
checks.detail: Parsed-JSON diff against HEAD (41a4fa01...) shows only the 8 paths in changed_protocol_paths. partition, budget, ceilings, questions, case_matrix, code pins, oracle_policy, legacy_inputs, freeze (supporting_artifacts unchanged, 15 entries), correction_approval, p9, claim_limits and the other recipes fields are unchanged.

checks.question: 2. Bound files byte-identical and listed hashes match
checks.detail: git diff HEAD is empty for MANIFEST.json, inputs/, oracles/, certificates/, independent-review.json, quality-review.json, authoring-validation.json, review-package.json and evaluation/inquiry-p8. freeze.manifest_sha256, all 15 supporting_artifacts, generator/independent_audit_tool/certificate_producer sha256 and all 10 additional_helpers match current bytes.

checks.question: 3. Repeated-requests wording true
checks.detail: Unchanged since round 1 and the manifest is byte-identical: all 96 cases expect 'results'; max counter/limit ratio over the 16 repeated-requests cases is 352/1000 pairs (T01-repeated-requests-8); expected_embedded_event_count is 0 against limit 8.

checks.question: 4. repository_cost accurate
checks.detail: Independently measured from git ls-files -s blob ids deduplicated and sized with git cat-file --batch-check: unique content of the failed capture, replay and preflight directories is 68,187,944 B (about 68.2 MB), matching the claim; packed on-disk size is 48,149,535 B, and the text correctly says 'unique content', not packed size. Working-tree size per capture/replay directory is 62,499,109 / 62,494,088 B (about 62 MB); lean.gz is 41,928,158 B (about 42 MB); preflight unique content 6,085,959 B (about 6 MB); capture and replay share blob ids for all three binaries. 'A new run should add a similar amount' is a reasonable estimate.

checks.question: 5. Self-consistency and loader enforcement of approval_location
checks.detail: The amendment approval_location now claims one entry with this id, a non-blank approval_text string and interpretation_sha256 of the UTF-8 interpretation; the loader requires a list of objects, unique ids, isinstance str and non-blank after strip, and the interpretation hash. The data_policy approval_location spells out json_bytes exactly (sort_keys, ',' ':' separators, ensure_ascii false, UTF-8, trailing LF), matching json_bytes; the loader requires 'data_policy' in protocol to be a dict with state requires-correction-receipt and a matching data_policy_sha256. Non-deferred amendments still require provenance user and non-blank approval_text. The check runs only on the non-@1 path after the candidate snapshot comparison.

checks.question: 6. README accuracy
checks.detail: README matches the loader on field names, the one-entry-per-id rule, non-blank approval text, UTF-8 interpretation hash, json_bytes encoding with trailing newline, and the refusal behavior. Its cost paragraph matches repository_cost and the measurement.

checks.question: 7. No weakening of the original suite
checks.detail: evaluation/inquiry-p8 is byte-identical to HEAD and pins no loader hash; require_receipt_approvals is reachable only for recipe versions other than inquiry-p8-recipes@1; load_suite(evaluation/inquiry-p8/MANIFEST.json) succeeds and the original generator --check passes.

checks.question: Round-1 finding 4: binding supplemental receipts via review-package.json
checks.detail: The circularity argument holds: each receipt binds the protocol SHA256, so the protocol cannot list them. Binding them in review-package.json, inside the committed candidate whose full SHA the researcher receipt names, is adequate for spec purposes. Caveats recorded as low findings: review-package.json is still byte-identical to HEAD (binding not yet done), and load_suite checks only the commit's format, not its content.

checks.question: Commands run
checks.detail: test/inquiry_approval_receipt.py: 3 tests OK; test/inquiry_corrected_candidates.py: 16 tests OK; corrected generator --check: 96 cases checked; independent_finite_audit.py: AUTHORING-CHECK, 80 exact checks, no findings; original generator --check OK. No driver or consumer run.

findings.detail: Supplemental receipts are not yet bound anywhere: review-package.json is unchanged from HEAD. The planned binding must land in the commit the researcher approves. load_suite verifies only that reviewed_candidate_commit is 40 hex characters, so this binding rests on the researcher reviewing that commit, not on the loader.

repository_cost says the preflight directory is committed, but data_policy names only local_capture_directory and local_replay_directory and gives no preflight location. Consider naming ara/evidence/inquiry-p8/preflight-<fresh-run-id> so the policy covers every committed directory.

require_receipt_approvals accepts receipt entries for ids the protocol does not defer (silently ignored), and an unhashable id (e.g. a list) raises TypeError rather than ValueError. Neither lets an unapproved item through.
